thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: High p95 latency detected for redwood-7b-v2 in us-west-2. kvcache.eviction_rate abnormal; cont-batch timeouts increasing. Triggering auto-escalation to #incidents.

anna_oncall: Picking up the page (oncall). Pulling up dashboards and recent deploys.

sam_sre: saw customer-side 502/504s around 14:02 PDT. Which config changed recently?

mike_runtime: I can see a config bump at 13:57 from config-service: default cont-batch.max_batch_tokens increased to 262144. Also per-worker memory pressure on kvcache nodes.

iris_support: Confirmed ACME reported elevated errors in support ticket 4321. They attached request traces showing retries and upstream timeouts.

anna_oncall: Can someone post the exact config diff?

devops_bot: Config change: `cont-batch.max_batch_tokens: 65536 -> 262144` applied by ci-bot at 13:57:12 PDT.

sam_sre: That explains it. Larger batches => bigger KV footprints for prefix caching, combined with uneven hot sequence distribution -> cache blowout. Recommend immediate rollback of that config.

mike_runtime: Also propose lowering max_num_seqs to reduce per-batch KV amplification, and bump request timeout so clients don't see 504 while we stabilize. Suggested interim values: `max_batch_tokens=65536`, `max_num_seqs=48`, `request_timeout_ms=8000`.

anna_oncall: I'll patch the config map to revert. Running patch now.

anna_oncall: Command issued: ```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_tokens":"65536","max_num_seqs":"48","request_timeout_ms":"8000"}}'
```

incidentbot: Config patch job started by anna_oncall at 14:09:40 PDT.

mike_runtime: Rolling restart of cont-batch pods to pick up the new config: `kubectl -n runtime rollout restart daemonset/cont-batch`

sam_sre: To limit blast radius, set a model-specific override to disable continuous batching for redwood-7b-v2 until we can validate: POST /models/redwood-7b-v2/overrides {cont_batch_enabled:false}.

anna_oncall: Override applied via admin API. Response 200.

iris_support: ACME reporting error rate dropping to ~6% from 30% after the override. Sending them a brief update.

mike_runtime: Observability: kvcache.eviction_rate back down from ~21k/min to ~1100/min after rollback in the past 4 mins. cont-batch queue lengths decreasing; overall p95 latency trending below 500ms.

anna_oncall: Good. Keeping the model override in place while we run tests. Recording timeline: 13:57 change -> 14:09 rollback; ~12 minutes of customer impact.

sam_sre: Opening INCIDENT-4337 with logs and config diffs. Will include counts: estimated ~30% errors for ACME in the window.

julia_pm: ACME has an SLA. Need a short summary for CX: timeline, what happened, mitigation, next steps.

iris_support: I'll draft the customer-facing note after Sam adds impact numbers.

mike_runtime: Preliminary root cause: unsafe default increase to max_batch_tokens in a global config. Under hot prefix traffic patterns, per-batch KV working set grew significantly causing memory pressure and eviction storms; evictions caused widespread cache misses -> increased latency -> cont-batch producers stalled and timed out.

anna_oncall: Action items before handoff: 1) keep override for redwood-7b-v2, 2) ensure rollback guard in CI to prevent >2x increases without manual review, 3) add kvcache memory-pressure alert (SLO threshold), 4) run synthetic stress test with long prefixes against staging.

sam_sre: I'll take postmortem and link RCC (repro checklist) in INCIDENT-4337. Will propose safe defaults: max_batch_tokens=65536, max_num_seqs<=64, cont_batch_timeout_ms default 5000, and autoscale for kvcache memory.

mike_runtime: Also recommend adding a canary job that emits high-prefix queries hourly to catch this in staging, plus an e2e test that validates kvcache resident size under config changes.

anna_oncall: Marking incident mitigated. Sam, taking handoff for investigation and follow-ups. Im turning over oncall. :wave:

sam_sre: Taking handoff. Will coordinate postmortem and customer comms tomorrow. Thanks all.

incidentbot: Incident resolved at 14:14:40 PDT. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated.

--
Follow-ups (brief):
- sam_sre: open INCIDENT-4337, postmortem + impact numbers
- mike_runtime: add kvcache mem alert + add prefix canary
- anna_oncall: validate and harden rollback guard in CI
- iris_support: send ACME incident summary and timeline
- eng-runtime: run config safety tests and propose global safe defaults
